answer_1.quote: Timeline summarization aims at generating a sequence of major news events with their key dates...
models: Event Graph Compression Model with Optimal Transport
answer_1.outputs: Timeline summaries (sequences of event summaries ordered by dates)

answer_2.quote: We use the conventional metrics for timeline summarization to evaluate the key date selection using Date F1 and the content generation using ROUGE scores, including (1) concat F1... (2) agree F1... (3) align F1...

answer_4.quote: We instruct the human annotators to read 15 randomly sampled reference timelines, and rate summaries generated by our system and baselines on a 1-5 point scale... The timelines are evaluated in the following dimensions: (1) general score... (2) coverage score... (3) coherence score... (4) temporal preserving score...
answer_4.guideline: Rate summaries on a 1-5 scale for general quality, coverage, coherence, and temporal preserving
